description:
At Noctua Technology , we don't just build software, we pride ourselves on pure engineering excellence. As a small, specialized professional services company, we partner with both public sector and commercial customers to solve complex, high-impact challenges.

 We are experiencing exciting growth and are always looking for brilliant minds to join our team. If you don't see an exact match for your role right now, this generic posting is the perfect place to share your background with us for future opportunities.

 What We Do: Core Focus Areas 

 We hire software engineers across a variety of disciplines. If your expertise falls into any of the following buckets, we want to hear from you:

 
 Application Development: Crafting robust, scalable, and modern applications.

 Data Engineering: Building efficient data pipelines, architectures, and storage solutions.

 AI/ML: Developing and deploying intelligent models to solve real-world problems.

 Cloud Infrastructure/ SRE: Architecting secure, resilient, and optimized cloud environments.

 
 How We Work 

 
 Remote-First: We are a fully remote company, though we do head onsite to customer locations as needed. We hire engineers located in California, Virginia, Maryland, and D.C. to ensure proximity to customers.

 Our Footprint: We are headquartered in San Diego, CA, with a presence across the Southwest and the DC metro area.

 Finding Your Perfect Fit: Because we support a diverse portfolio of clients, we don't force you into a box. As we progress through the interview process, we’ll map your unique skill sets and location preferences to the best possible project alignment.

 
 A Note on Timing & Next Steps 

 Our project pipeline moves fast. Depending on our active contracts, we might have the perfect project lined up for you to jump into immediately, or we may be building a relationship with you for a future need. Either way, we promise to keep you closely aligned on where things stand as we move through the process together.

 If you are driven by engineering excellence and want to be part of a growing, dynamic team, submit your resume and interest today!
